errors.hrm.assignment.cost_shares: Each cost share needs either a cost centre or a department, and a percent above 0 and at most 100.
errors.hrm.assignment.cost_sum: The cost shares must add up to exactly 100 percent.
errors.hrm.assignment.fte_range: The full-time equivalent must be above 0 and at most 1.
errors.hrm.assignment.manager_cycle: This manager would make a reporting circle: the employee is already above this manager.
errors.hrm.assignment.manager_not_curren: The manager must be a current employee of the same company.
errors.hrm.assignment.not_in_company: This is not a record of the employment's company.
errors.hrm.assignment.own_manager: An employee cannot be their own manager.
errors.hrm.employment.already_confirmed: This employment is already confirmed. Correct the confirmation instead.
errors.hrm.employment.already_employed: This person already has a current main employment.
errors.hrm.employment.before_joining: A change cannot take effect before the joining date.
errors.hrm.employment.confirmation_befor: The confirmation date cannot be before the joining date.
errors.hrm.employment.employee_no_taken: This employee number is already used in the company. Numbers are never reused.
errors.hrm.employment.joining_after_toda: The joining date of an employee who has already joined cannot move into the future.
errors.hrm.employment.no_starting_assign: The changes leave the employment without job details on its first day.
errors.hrm.employment.not_current: This employment has ended or was cancelled, so it cannot be changed here.
errors.hrm.employment.person_or_new: Choose an existing person or enter a new one, not both.
errors.hrm.employment.termination_in_loc: The end date is before the last attendance or inside a locked payroll period. It needs an approved override.
errors.hrm.employment_event.already_corr: This change has already been corrected. Correct the latest correction instead.
errors.hrm.employment_event.confirmation: A confirmation changes no job details. Record the job change separately.
errors.hrm.employment_event.correction_n: Name the change to correct, or the employment fields or job details to correct from the date.
errors.hrm.employment_event.correction_p: A correction of this change is already waiting for approval.
errors.hrm.employment_event.correction_t: Only a correction can name a change to correct, and only a change that is in force or approved.
errors.hrm.employment_event.employment_f: Employment type and dates are changed only by a data correction.
errors.hrm.employment_event.kind_not_rec: This kind of change is recorded through its own service (hire, transfer to another company, separation, pay).
errors.hrm.employment_event.no_assignmen: Enter the job details that change.
errors.hrm.employment_event.not_found: The employment change was not found.
errors.hrm.employment_event.not_pending: This employment change is no longer waiting for approval.
errors.hrm.user_link.not_linked: This employment is not linked to a user.
errors.hrm.user_link.other_person: This user is already linked to another person's employment.
errors.hrm.user_link.user_linked: This user is already linked to a current employment in this company.
errors.hrm.user_link.user_not_found: No user with this id can be linked.
hrm.impact.not_backdated: The change is not dated in the past, so no earlier results are affected.
hrm.impact.nothing_affected: No locked periods or calculated results are affected.
hrm.impact.periods_flagged: Some periods are already calculated or locked. They will be recalculated, and locked ones adjusted in the next open payroll.
permissions.hrm.employments.link_user: Link employments to users and unlink them
permissions.hrm.employments.number_overr: Type an employee number instead of the next one
